projects.name: Banking Process Dashboard
projects.description: A dashboard concept for tracking tasks, workflow status, exceptions, and service timelines in an operations team.
projects.problem: Operations teams need quick visibility into pending work, SLA risk, and exception volume.
projects.approach: Create a simple dashboard layout with task status, priority, aging, exception notes, and owner fields.
